claim: SRS scheduling is 100% server-side: the client POSTs SrsRequest(personId, studiableContainerId, studiableContainerType, personTimezone, personTestDate, clientLatestAnswers) to https://api.quizlet.com/3.11/srs/status with body {"srs": {...}}; no scheduling math exists in the client.
observed_fact: Read SrsRequest.java fully: 6 fields incl. personTimezone and personTestDate. Read srs/c.java: URL = b.a(bVar, "srs", "status", 12). This is the single most important extraction: Family OS must build (not extract) the scheduling formula.

claim: The API base URL pattern is https://<host>/3.11/<resource>/<action> and the host is https://api.quizlet.com (hardcoded in OkHttp interceptors).
